from manim import *

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section2Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        # Initialize the layout with the specific title and lecture lines
        self.setup_layout("Prerequisite: The Vector Map", [
            "We can map quantum possibilities using 2D geometry.",

            "A quantum state is an arrow within this space."
        ])
        
        # Define key points on the grid
        origin = self.grid["E2"]
        y_tip = self.grid["B2"]
        x_tip = self.grid["E5"]

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        # Line: "We can map quantum possibilities using 2D geometry."
        # Action: Introduce the coordinate system structure.
        self.lecture[0].set_color(WHITE)
        
        # Create initial white axes
        y_axis = Arrow(start=origin, end=y_tip, buff=0, color=WHITE, stroke_width=2)

        self.play(Create(y_axis), Create(x_axis))

        self.place_at_grid(x_label, "E6", scale_factor=0.8) # 1 unit right of the x-axis tip

        self.play(
            y_axis.animate.set_color("#FFFF00"),

            Write(y_label),
            Write(x_label)
        )
        self.wait(1)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        # Line: "A quantum state is an arrow within this space."
        # Action: Draw the state vectors representing 100% outcomes.
        self.play(
            self.lecture[1].set_color(GRAY),
            self.lecture[2].set_color(WHITE)
        )
        
        # State vector for |Heads>
        v_heads = Arrow(start=origin, end=y_tip, buff=0, color=WHITE, stroke_width=6)
        # State vector for |Tails>
        v_tails = Arrow(start=origin, end=x_tip, buff=0, color=WHITE, stroke_width=6)
        
        # Animate the vectors appearing
        self.play(Create(v_heads))
        self.wait(0.5)
        self.play(Create(v_tails))
        
        self.wait(2)
